CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS container_tss_monitoring (
    containregistry VARCHAR,
    latest_tss NUMERIC,
    last_updated TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

    c.containregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(

        (1 - CAST(sd.critevents AS NUMERIC) / 10) *
